# A package key holds an array of entries, one per muxt generate run. Two entries
# of one package write two route files, each with its own routes function,
# receiver interface and types, and the package compiles and serves both.

muxt generate
exists routes_public.go
exists routes_admin.go
! exists template_routes.go

muxt check
stdout 'example.com/m \(routes_public.go\)'
stdout 'example.com/m \(routes_admin.go\)'

exec go test ./...

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
  "packages": {
    "example.com/m": [
      {
        "use_templates_variable": [
          "publicTmpl"
        ],
        "use_receiver_type": "public",
        "output_file": "routes_public.go",
        "output_routes_func": "PublicRoutes",
        "output_receiver_interface": "PublicHandler",
        "output_template_data_type": "PublicData",
        "output_template_route_paths_type": "PublicPaths"
      },
      {
        "use_templates_variable": [
          "adminTmpl"
        ],
        "use_receiver_type": "admin",
        "output_file": "routes_admin.go",
        "output_routes_func": "AdminRoutes",
        "output_receiver_interface": "AdminHandler",
        "output_template_data_type": "AdminData",
        "output_template_route_paths_type": "AdminPaths"
      }
    ]
  }
}
-- web.go --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed public.gohtml admin.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var (
	publicTmpl = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "public.gohtml"))
	adminTmpl  = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "admin.gohtml"))
)

type public struct{}

func (public) Home(context.Context) string { return "welcome" }

type admin struct{}

func (admin) Dashboard(context.Context) string { return "dashboard" }
-- public.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Home(ctx)"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>{{end}}
-- admin.gohtml --
{{define "GET /admin Dashboard(ctx)"}}<h2>{{.Result}}</h2>{{end}}
-- web_test.go --
package main

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestEachRoutesFunctionServesItsRoutes(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	PublicRoutes(mux, public{})
	AdminRoutes(mux, admin{})

	for _, tt := range []struct {
		path, want string
	}{
		{PublicPaths{}.Home(), "<h1>welcome</h1>"},
		{AdminPaths{}.Dashboard(), "<h2>dashboard</h2>"},
	} {
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, tt.path, nil))
		if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("GET %s status = %d, want %d", tt.path, got, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, tt.want) {
			t.Errorf("GET %s body = %q, want it to contain %q", tt.path, body, tt.want)
		}
	}
}
